changelog: **Authoring assist and paste-in profile enrichment (#2055, part 2):** "Draft in 3 languages" on the announcement composer and the goal/message-template forms turns a short brief into an EN/TR/DE draft (`POST /api/admin/ai/draft`, task `content_draft`), offered only while every language is empty and folded in through `mergeMachine`, so every drafted locale is marked machine-written until reviewed and nothing a person wrote can be replaced. Mentors get "Suggest from pasted text" on their profile (`POST /api/profile/enrich`, task `profile_enrich` — participant-side and free, gated on their own `AI_CV_PARSING` consent): a proposed bio, expertise and interests, each accepted or skipped on its own and only stored by the form's Save; admins get the same for a company's description and industry (`POST /api/admin/ai/company-enrich`, task `company_enrich`). Input is pasted text only — no URL is fetched and no profile scraped, and `scripts/test/authoring-assist.test.mjs` asserts statically that none of these modules fetches or writes; all of them are also in the never-auto-send list. Nothing is published, queued or sent by any of it.

en: Turn a one-line brief into an announcement or template in all three languages, and let mentors fill their profile from a pasted career summary — every suggestion is yours to accept or skip, and nothing is sent or saved without you.
tr: Tek satırlık bir nottan üç dilde duyuru ya da şablon taslağı oluştur; mentorlar da yapıştırdıkları kariyer özetinden profillerini doldursun — her öneriyi sen kabul eder ya da geçersin, sen istemeden hiçbir şey gönderilmez ya da kaydedilmez.
de: Mach aus einer Kurzinfo eine Ankündigung oder Vorlage in allen drei Sprachen, und Mentor:innen füllen ihr Profil aus einem eingefügten Karriereüberblick — jeden Vorschlag übernimmst oder überspringst du selbst, und ohne dich wird nichts gesendet oder gespeichert.
